sections.title: The reply repeats the form
sections.content: A shop question contains the object, and the object tells you which form to use in the reply. With *egy* or a bare noun, the question and the answer use the endings you know: *Kérsz tejet? – Kérek.* With *a / az* + noun, both use the definite endings: *Kéred a tejet? – Kérem.* To say no, put *nem* before the verb: *Nem kérem.* The object can come first to stress it: *A tejet kérem.*

items.english: Do you want cheese? – Yes, please.
Do you want the cheese? – Yes, I'll take it.

sections.content: Listen for the object in the question. *Tejet* with no article is any milk, so the answer is *Kérek*. *A tejet* is the milk you can see, so the answer is *Kérem*.
